question: State the persons who are not eligible for appointment as auditor of a company under the Companies Act, 2013.
sources: Companies Act, 2013, section 141 (eligibility, qualifications and disqualifications of auditors)

points.label: Body corporate, officer or employee
points.description: A body corporate other than an LLP, an officer or employee of the company, and a partner or employee of an officer or employee of the company cannot be appointed.

points.label: Holding securities or interest
points.description: A person who, or whose relative or partner, holds any security of or interest in the company, its subsidiary, holding or associate company (a relative may hold securities up to the limit prescribed in the Rules).
points.basis: Companies Act, 2013, section 141(3); Companies (Audit and Auditors) Rules, 2014

points.label: Indebtedness or guarantee
points.description: A person who, or whose relative or partner, is indebted to, or has given a guarantee or security for the debts of, the company or its group companies beyond the prescribed amount.
points.basis: Companies Act, 2013, section 141(3); Companies (Audit and Auditors) Rules, 2014

points.label: Business relationship and relatives in management
points.description: A person who has a business relationship with the company or its group companies, or whose relative is a director or key managerial personnel of the company.

points.label: Employment, audit limit and fraud conviction
points.description: A person in full-time employment elsewhere, a person who would exceed the limit of 20 company audits, and a person convicted of an offence involving fraud within the last 10 years.

points.label: Restricted services and later disqualification
points.description: A person who provides the services barred by section 144 to the company or its group companies is also disqualified; an auditor who becomes disqualified after appointment vacates office.
